{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I've been thinking about Highnote and wanted to check in to see how things are going on your end.

If it would be useful, I'd be glad to set up a 20-minute call in the next few weeks to hear what you're focused on and where things are heading. No agenda beyond catching up.

Either way, I'm cheering you and the team on.

Best,
Maya"}
